alt.zh: ANDY 与 YUEZHANG 共同创立

body.zh: 公司以“谋杀之谜”剧本创作与发行为起点，为超过一万名顾客提供相关服务。对故事与玩家体验的关注，也成为后来开发桌游的基础。
body.en: Founded by ANDY and YUEZHANG, the company began by creating and publishing murder mystery scenarios, serving more than 10,000 customers. That focus on storytelling and player experience laid the groundwork for its board games.

title.en: A focus on original board games

body.zh: 品牌转型为专注桌游设计的原创公司，将叙事创作经验带入游戏开发，探索故事、机制与桌面互动的结合。
body.en: The company shifted its focus to original board game design, bringing its experience in storytelling to the interplay of narrative, mechanics and tabletop interaction.

alt.zh: 五年打磨，中国故事上桌

body.zh: 历经五年开发，《彼岸之烛》登陆摩点，以中国传统文化为背景，融合原创故事与精致模型。截至 2025 年，项目位列中文原创桌游众筹金额第二名。
body.en: After five years in development, Netherworld Candle launched on Modian, combining an original story rooted in traditional Chinese culture with detailed miniatures. As of 2025, it ranked second among Chinese original board games by crowdfunding amount.

body.zh: 《彼岸之烛》发货后收获众多玩家好评，并于 2025 年获得 GOLDEN DICE 最佳原创奖。这份认可鼓励团队继续投入原创开发。
body.en: Following delivery and positive feedback from players, Netherworld Candle received the GOLDEN DICE award for Best Original Game in 2025, encouraging the team to continue investing in original development.

alt.zh: 让更多好游戏走近中文玩家
alt.en: Bringing more games to Chinese-speaking players

body.zh: 持续引入《阿格莫尼亚》《空寂之钟》《幽影迷航》《SHEOL》等项目，发展国际游戏本地化代理业务。依托积累的客户资源与玩家社群，推进中文市场发行。
body.en: The company expanded its localisation and publishing work with titles including Agemonia and SHEOL. Established customer relationships and player communities support the continued growth of its Chinese-language catalogue.

alt.zh: 原创开发 · 代理引进 · 海外推广

body.zh: 围绕原创开发、代理引进与海外推广，持续完善生产质控、物流仓储和交付售后体系。在深耕国内市场的同时，推动优质中国原创桌游走向国际。
body.en: Original development, Chinese-language publishing and international outreach guide our next chapter. Alongside our work in China, we are strengthening production quality, logistics and after-sales support to bring Chinese original games to more tables worldwide.
